description:
The image showcases a sleek and modern kitchen, featuring white cabinets and countertops with a wooden top.

In the foreground, a window on the left side of the image allows natural light to illuminate the space. On the left side of the image, a row of white cabinets is situated next to a white oven with black knobs. In the middle ground, a doorway leads to another room, while a white island with a wooden top stands in the center of the room, situated to the right of the doorway.
